#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Semplice script per plottare (sopra frames del tiff) i punti rossi corrispondenti alle celle per le quali è stata trovata 'cell_info' == True ma 'fa' <= fa_threshold.
Input: - tiff file path (stack) - parameter file (same format usato da st_analysis/plot_vectors_on_frames) - R .npy file (output di st_analysis) - fa_threshold (float)
Output: una cartella di TIFF (uno per ogni frame z dove ci sono punti) con i punti sovrapposti.
Esempio d'uso: python plot_rejected_fa_cells.py -s /path/to/stack.tif -p parameters.txt -r /path/to/R_sample.npy -f 0.30 -o out_folder
Autore: generato automaticamente """
import os import argparse import numpy as np import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from io import BytesIO from PIL import Image
# utilitarie dal progetto from custom_tool_kit import manage_path_argument, search_value_in_txt, shape_P_from_parameters from custom_image_base_tool import imread as tif_read, normalize, save_tiff from disarray_tools import Param
def parse_parameters(param_filepath): # param_names like in st_analysis param_names = ['roi_xy_pix', 'px_size_xy', 'px_size_z', 'mode_ratio', 'threshold_on_cell_ratio', 'fwhm_xy', 'fwhm_z'] values = search_value_in_txt(param_filepath, param_names) parameters = {} for i, name in enumerate(param_names): try: parameters[name] = float(values[i]) except Exception: # fallback: keep as string if not convertible parameters[name] = values[i] return parameters
def collect_rejected_points(R, shape_P, fa_threshold): """ Scansiona la matrice strutturata R e raccoglie, per ogni z (slice in voxel), la lista di centri (row, col) delle celle che soddisfano cell_info == True and fa <= fa_threshold.
R: numpy structured ndarray (shape: nR = (nr, nc, nz)) shape_P: array-like (roi_xy_pix, roi_xy_pix, depth_in_slices) fa_threshold: float
Returns: dict mapping z_slice_index -> list of (col, row) coordinates (int) """ rejected_by_z = {} # iterate on indices # R may be e.g. shape (nr, nc, nz) nr, nc, nz = R.shape
for r in range(nr): for c in range(nc): for z in range(nz): try: entry = R[r, c, z] except Exception: continue
# check cell_info flag cell_ok = bool(entry[Param.CELL_INFO]) if Param.CELL_INFO in entry.dtype.names else False # read fa fa_val = entry[Param.FA] if Param.FA in entry.dtype.names else np.nan
if cell_ok: try: # Some entries may have NaN or invalid values if np.isnan(fa_val): consider_rejected = True if fa_val == 0 else False else: consider_rejected = float(fa_val) <= float(fa_threshold) except Exception: consider_rejected = False
if consider_rejected: # get init_coord (could be stored as (1,3) array or (3,)) init_coord = entry[Param.INIT_COORD] if Param.INIT_COORD in entry.dtype.names else None if init_coord is None: continue # flatten try: init = np.array(init_coord).reshape(-1)[0:3] except Exception: # fallback: try to index try: init = np.array([init_coord[0], init_coord[1], init_coord[2]]) except Exception: continue
# compute center in voxel coordinates center_row = int(init[0] + shape_P[0] / 2.0) center_col = int(init[1] + shape_P[1] / 2.0) center_z = int(init[2] + shape_P[2] / 2.0)
# append if center_z not in rejected_by_z: rejected_by_z[center_z] = [] rejected_by_z[center_z].append((center_col, center_row))
return rejected_by_z
def plot_and_save_frames(volume_rcz, rejected_by_z, out_folder, base_name='rejected_fa', marker_size=6): """ volume_rcz: numpy array shaped (rows, cols, z) rejected_by_z: dict z -> list of (x=col,y=row) out_folder: directory to save tiff frames base_name: base filename marker_size: scatter size """ if not os.path.isdir(out_folder): os.makedirs(out_folder, exist_ok=True)
rows = volume_rcz.shape[0] cols = volume_rcz.shape[1]
for z_slice, coords in sorted(rejected_by_z.items()): # guardare i limiti if z_slice < 0 or z_slice >= volume_rcz.shape[2]: print(f"Warning: z_slice {z_slice} out of bounds for volume with depth {volume_rcz.shape[2]}") continue
img = volume_rcz[:, :, z_slice] # normalize to 0..255 uint8 img_uint8 = normalize(img, max_value=255.0, dtype=np.uint8)
# prepare figure without borders, size in inches = pixels (dpi=1) fig = plt.figure(frameon=False) fig.set_size_inches(cols, rows) ax = plt.Axes(fig, [0., 0., 1., 1.]) ax.set_axis_off() fig.add_axes(ax)
ax.imshow(img_uint8, cmap='gray', vmin=0, vmax=255)
# scatter red dots if len(coords) > 0: xs = [p[0] for p in coords] ys = [p[1] for p in coords] ax.scatter(xs, ys, s=marker_size, c='red', marker='o')
fname = f"{base_name}_z={z_slice}.tiff" outpath = os.path.join(out_folder, fname) # save as tiff with dpi=1 fig.savefig(outpath, dpi=1) plt.close(fig) print(f"Saved {outpath}")
return out_folder
def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Plot red dots for cells rejected by FA threshold on tiff frames') parser.add_argument('-s', '--source-path', required=True, nargs=1, help='Path to input tiff stack') parser.add_argument('-p', '--parameters-filename', required=True, nargs=1, help='Parameter filename (in same folder)') parser.add_argument('-r', '--R-path', required=True, help='Path to R .npy file') parser.add_argument('-f', '--fa-threshold', required=True, type=float, help='FA threshold (float)') parser.add_argument('-o', '--out-folder', required=False, default=None, help='Output folder to save tiff frames') parser.add_argument('--marker-size', required=False, type=float, default=6.0, help='Marker size for scatter') args = parser.parse_args()
tiff_path = manage_path_argument(args.source_path) param_filename = args.parameters_filename[0] R_path = args.R_path fa_threshold = args.fa_threshold out_folder = args.out_folder
if tiff_path is None or not os.path.isfile(tiff_path): raise ValueError(f"Tiff stack not found: {tiff_path}") if not os.path.isfile(R_path): raise ValueError(f"R file not found: {R_path}")
# build parameter filepath (assume same folder as tiff) basepath = os.path.dirname(tiff_path) param_fpath = os.path.join(basepath, param_filename) if not os.path.isfile(param_fpath): # try the provided path as absolute param_fpath = param_filename if not os.path.isfile(param_fpath): raise ValueError(f"Parameters file not found at {param_filename} nor at {os.path.join(basepath, param_filename)}")
print('Loading parameters...') parameters = parse_parameters(param_fpath) shape_P = shape_P_from_parameters(parameters) print('Computed shape_P:', shape_P)
print('Loading R matrix...') R = np.load(R_path, allow_pickle=True) print('R.shape:', R.shape)
print('Collecting rejected points (cell_info True and fa <= threshold)...') rejected_by_z = collect_rejected_points(R, shape_P, fa_threshold) print(f'Found rejected points on {len(rejected_by_z)} distinct z slices')
# load tiff and move axis to (r,c,z) like in plot_vectors_on_frames print('Loading tiff stack...') vol = tif_read(tiff_path) # usually shape (z,y,x) vol_rcz = np.moveaxis(vol, 0, -1) # (z,y,x) -> (y,x,z) => (rows, cols, z)
# prepare output folder if out_folder is None: rbase = os.path.dirname(R_path) rbname = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(R_path))[0] out_folder = os.path.join(rbase, rbname + '_rejected_fa_plots')
print('Plotting and saving frames...') plot_and_save_frames(vol_rcz, rejected_by_z, out_folder, base_name=os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(R_path))[0], marker_size=args.marker_size)
print('Done. Output folder:', out_folder)
if __name__ == '__main__': main()

R: numpy structured ndarray (shape: nR = (nr, nc, nz)) shape_P: array-like (roi_xy_pix, roi_xy_pix, depth_in_slices) fa_threshold: float
Returns: dict mapping z_slice_index -> list of (col, row) coordinates (int) """ rejected_by_z = {} # iterate on indices # R may be e.g. shape (nr, nc, nz) nr, nc, nz = R.shape

if cell_ok: try: # Some entries may have NaN or invalid values if isinstance(fa_val, np.ndarray): # sometimes fa is stored as (1,) array fa_scalar = float(np.array(fa_val).reshape(-1)[0]) else: fa_scalar = float(fa_val) consider_rejected = np.isnan(fa_scalar) and False or (fa_scalar <= float(fa_threshold)) except Exception: # if cannot parse fa, skip consider_rejected = False
if consider_rejected: # Prefer to compute center from block indices (r,c,z) to match how plotting # maps block -> slice: center = (index + 0.5) * shape_P center_row = int((r + 0.5) * float(shape_P[0])) center_col = int((c + 0.5) * float(shape_P[1])) center_z = int((z + 0.5) * float(shape_P[2]))
# fallback: if INIT_COORD is present and seems valid, use it to compute center if Param.INIT_COORD in entry.dtype.names: try: init_coord = entry[Param.INIT_COORD] init = np.array(init_coord).reshape(-1)[0:3] # average between init-based center and index-based center (choose init if inside) init_center_z = int(init[2] + shape_P[2] / 2.0) init_center_row = int(init[0] + shape_P[0] / 2.0) init_center_col = int(init[1] + shape_P[1] / 2.0) # use init_center if it is a reasonable non-negative integer if init_center_z >= 0: center_z = init_center_z if init_center_row >= 0: center_row = init_center_row if init_center_col >= 0: center_col = init_center_col except Exception: pass
# append if center_z not in rejected_by_z: rejected_by_z[center_z] = [] rejected_by_z[center_z].append((center_col, center_row))
return rejected_by_z
def _draw_dots_on_image(img_uint8, coords, marker_radius=6, color=(255, 0, 0)): """ Disegna pallini (filled circles) sull'immagine grayscale convertita in RGB. - img_uint8: 2D numpy uint8 array - coords: list of (x=col, y=row) - marker_radius: radius in pixels - color: RGB tuple Returns: PIL.Image """ # convert grayscale to RGB pil = Image.fromarray(img_uint8).convert('RGB') draw = ImageDraw.Draw(pil)
w, h = pil.size # note: PIL size is (width=cols, height=rows)
out_of_bounds = 0 for (x, y) in coords: # ensure integer xi = int(round(x)) yi = int(round(y)) # check bounds if xi < 0 or xi >= w or yi < 0 or yi >= h: out_of_bounds += 1 continue # ellipse bbox bbox = [xi - marker_radius, yi - marker_radius, xi + marker_radius, yi + marker_radius] draw.ellipse(bbox, fill=color)
return pil, out_of_bounds
def plot_and_save_frames(volume_rcz, rejected_by_z, out_folder, base_name='rejected_fa', marker_size=6): """ volume_rcz: numpy array shaped (rows, cols, z) rejected_by_z: dict z -> list of (x=col,y=row) out_folder: directory to save tiff frames base_name: base filename marker_size: marker radius in pixels (int) """ if not os.path.isdir(out_folder): os.makedirs(out_folder, exist_ok=True)
rows = volume_rcz.shape[0] cols = volume_rcz.shape[1]
for z_slice, coords in sorted(rejected_by_z.items()): # guardare i limiti if z_slice < 0 or z_slice >= volume_rcz.shape[2]: print(f"Warning: z_slice {z_slice} out of bounds for volume with depth {volume_rcz.shape[2]}") continue
img = volume_rcz[:, :, z_slice] # normalize to 0..255 uint8 img_uint8 = normalize(img, max_value=255.0, dtype=np.uint8)
# diagnostics n_coords = len(coords) if n_coords == 0: print(f"z={z_slice}: no rejected coords -> skipping save") continue xs = [p[0] for p in coords] ys = [p[1] for p in coords] xmin, xmax = np.min(xs), np.max(xs) ymin, ymax = np.min(ys), np.max(ys) print(f"z={z_slice}: drawing {n_coords} points, x range: [{xmin},{xmax}], y range: [{ymin},{ymax}], image size (cols,rows)=({cols},{rows})")
# draw dots using PIL for pixel-accurate result pil_img, oob = _draw_dots_on_image(img_uint8, coords, marker_radius=int(round(marker_size)), color=(255, 0, 0)) if oob > 0: print(f" Note: {oob} points were out of image bounds and were skipped")
fname = f"{base_name}_z={z_slice}.tiff" outpath = os.path.join(out_folder, fname) pil_img.save(outpath) print(f"Saved {outpath}")
return out_folder

import numpy as np import os from tifffile import imwrite
